name: airplane-window-gallery
title: Airplane Window Gallery
description: A cabin wall with 2-5 oval airplane windows, each showing a destination that drifts slowly as if flying, with seat number above and place + country below. With autoplay a window shade drops and lifts on a new destination. Click a window to fly through it - the view zooms out of the oval to fill the card with title, location and caption - then click / Escape / 'Sit back' to return.
darkMode: shadcn tokens with dark: variants (the cabin uses primary in dark mode) - follows the theme
mainProps: items: {src, title?, location?, caption?, alt?}[], windows (2-5), autoplay, interval, drift (s, 0 = still), shadeDuration, firstRow, onLookOut, activeWindow/onActiveWindowChange, plus any <div> props
notes: Card with aspect-ratio 3/2 - set a max width (e.g. max-w-[640px]). React 19 (ref as prop). Autoplay needs more items than windows. Same 'zoom out of the opening' technique as elevator-doors-gallery. Fixed: views loaded before hydration stayed invisible (onLoad missed). Original by CCgather - keep the credit.
